title: No-Letter Clue · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play No-Letter Clue · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a familiar object and a letter it contains. The lead describes the object without using that letter in the spoken clue; the others guess it. The group guesses and the clue avoids the selected letter. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In No-Letter Clue, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group guesses and the clue avoids the selected letter.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The group guesses and the clue avoids the selected letter.
